description: Block B items 7-8: AI-generated freelance responses + Thompson Sampling for A/B testing. Add freelance_automation/ai_responder.py that generates unique responses via LLM. Replace chi-squared with Thompson Sampling in ad_testing/.
steps: Create freelance_automation/portfolio.py: Simple portfolio storage. PORTFOLIO_ITEMS list of dicts with {title, description, tags, url}. Function select_relevant(order: Order, top_k=3) -> list[str] that does keyword matching between order.title+description and portfolio tags to select most relevant items.

Integrate AI responder into freelance_automation/kwork.py: In respond_to_order, before filling textarea, check if ai_responder is available. If yes, generate AI response and use it instead of passed text parameter. Add optional parameter use_ai=True.
Integrate AI responder into freelance_automation/flru.py: Same pattern as kwork.py integration.
Modify freelance_automation/scheduler.py: Pass use_ai=True when calling respond_to_order on platforms.

Create ad_testing/thompson.py: ThompsonSamplingEngine class. Uses Beta distribution (scipy.stats.beta). Methods: sample_arm(alpha, beta) -> float (draw from Beta(alpha, beta)). select_best_arm(channels: list[dict]) -> str (sample each channel, return highest). update_arm(source_tag, is_conversion: bool) - increment alpha (success) or beta (failure). allocate_budget_thompson(total_budget, channels) -> dict[str, float] - sample, allocate proportionally to samples.

Add BetaParams to ad_testing/models.py: Add columns alpha_param REAL DEFAULT 1.0, beta_param REAL DEFAULT 1.0 to ad_channels table. Add functions: get_beta_params(source_tag) -> (alpha, beta), update_beta_params(source_tag, alpha, beta).

Modify ad_testing/engine.py: Add method allocate_budget_thompson(total_budget) that uses ThompsonSamplingEngine. Keep existing allocate_budget() as legacy. Add method record_event_thompson(source_tag, event_type) that also updates beta params on click/conversion.

Create tests/test_ai_responder.py: Mock ai_router.call_llm_text to return generated response. Test generate_response produces non-empty string. Test fallback when LLM returns empty. Test portfolio selection picks relevant items.

Create tests/test_thompson.py: Test sample_arm returns value in [0,1]. Test select_best_arm selects arm with highest alpha/beta ratio given enough samples. Test allocate_budget_thompson distributes budget proportionally. Test update_arm increments correct parameter.
Update requirements.txt: add 'numpy' (needed by scipy already, but make explicit for Thompson Sampling).
acceptance_criteria: ad_testing/thompson.py implements Thompson Sampling with Beta distribution
ruff check passes on all modified and new files
verification: ruff check freelance_automation/ai_responder.py freelance_automation/portfolio.py ad_testing/thompson.py ad_testing/engine.py ad_testing/models.py --select=E,F,I --ignore=F401,E501
python -c "from freelance_automation.ai_responder import AIResponder; from ad_testing.thompson import ThompsonSamplingEngine"
findings: All 28 tests pass. Pre-existing test failures confirmed: e2e tests need playwright install, test_telegram_keyboard_has_5_rows expects 5 rows (now 7), test_worker_settings_has_functions expects 3 (now 5). numpy added explicitly to requirements.txt. Ruff auto-fixed 3 import ordering issues.
